title: Shadow Log report
description: Stable stdout document printed by `shadow-log diff --json` (and `--format json`) and written to reports/<app>-<old>-to-<new>.json. schemaVersion is 1. Bump it, in the same change as this file, when the shape changes. See src/report/json.js.

id.description: Adapter id, or "local" for a path diff.

counts.description: One entry per category, including files. Keys: telemetry, apiPaths, domains, ipc, flags, configKeys, commands, i18n, deps, urls, files.

llm.description: Optional prose written by an LLM from the findings. Present only when an API key was already in the environment and --no-llm was not set. Unverified.

findings.description: Every extracted change, sorted by category, change, then value. Includes urls and individual UI strings. This is the complete list; notable is the ranked subset.

notable.description: Ranked highlights (same selection as the Markdown "Top findings"). File entries use category "files". Grouped UI strings use category "i18n-cluster". Capped by --top (default 10).

notes.description: Official release-note pages consulted for the cross-check. Omitted when --no-notes was set or the adapter has no notes.

reportFile.description: Basename of the Markdown report written beside this document.

spec.description: What was passed on the command line: app@version or a path.

version.description: Version label. For a local build, the path basename.

path.description: Absolute path. Present only for a local build.

source.description: Download URL or local artifact path the snapshot was built from.

date.description: Publish date (YYYY-MM-DD) when the adapter knows it.

files.description: Number of files in the unpacked bundle.

file.description: Path inside the unpacked bundle. Line numbers refer to the js-beautify output in .cache/<app>/<version>/pretty/<file>.

line.description: 1-based line. Omitted when the extractor has no line (package.json dependencies, locale JSON).

snippet.description: Short excerpt, at most about 160 characters.

category.description: telemetry, apiPaths, domains, ipc, flags, configKeys, commands, i18n, deps, urls, files, or (notable only) i18n-cluster.

title.description: Prose label. Present on notable entries.

before.description: Previous version (deps) or previous UI text (i18n) when change is "changed".

version.description: Dependency or bundled-library version, when known.

text.description: UI string text for an i18n finding.

referenced.description: For UI strings: whether any first-party code mentions the key. False is not proof the feature is unreleased.

vendorOnly.description: True when the only evidence is third-party code. Omitted otherwise.

officialStatus.description: Release-notes cross-check for a notable finding. absent means the search terms were not in the notes, not that the vendor concealed anything.

strings.description: Member strings of an i18n-cluster notable finding.
